# Issue forms

Use [New issue](https://github.com/lumetrium/definer/issues/new/choose) to choose the form that fits your report:

- [Bug report](bug.yml): describe a problem and how to reproduce it.
- [Feature request](feature.yml): explain the change you would find useful.
- [Source or catalog problem](source.yml): report a broken source, Script or prompt from this repository.

[config.yml](config.yml) adds a link to the Definer Wiki in the issue chooser. Including the requested version, platform and reproduction details makes reports easier to investigate.
